name: clipador
author: Joao Pster
description: Aplicativo desktop (Electron) do Clipador: gera clipes a partir de um link do YouTube ou video local, com o engine Python embutido, sem precisar instalar Python.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build
scripts.runtime:all: npm run runtime:python && npm run runtime:ffmpeg
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run runtime:all && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run runtime:all && electron-builder --win --publish always
